name: untangle
description: Review a pull request chain by chain, in your browser.

scripts.build: tsc -p . && node scripts/build-analyzer.mjs && esbuild viewer/highlight.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/highlight.js && esbuild viewer/fonts.css --bundle --loader:.woff2=dataurl --minify --legal-comments=inline --outfile=dist/fonts.css
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && rm -rf .coverage && mkdir -p .coverage/node .coverage/page && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=$PWD/.coverage/node UNTANGLE_VIEWER_COV=$PWD/.coverage/page node --test --test-force-exit "test/unit/**/*.test.ts" "test/server/**/*.test.ts" "test/e2e/**/*.test.ts"; node test/coverage.ts .coverage/node .coverage/page 3
